categories.main_business_segments: Chengdu Xiling PowerScience&Technology Incorporated Company primarily operates in two main segments: automotive engine parts and military & civil aviation parts. The automotive segment includes products such as turbochargers, crankshaft torsional dampers, connecting rod assemblies, and camshaft assemblies mainly for fuel and hybrid vehicles. The aviation segment focuses on processing aerospace structural parts, sheet metal parts, system parts, and various shaft components for military and civil aircraft.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced manufacturing technologies including precision casting, forging, heat treatment, and CNC machining. It has integrated capabilities from raw material processing to final assembly, especially for automotive engine components. R&D focuses on developing new materials, mechanical design, simulation, and automated production platforms, with ongoing projects in turbocharger performance testing, automated manufacturing, and new energy vehicle components.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include major domestic and international automotive manufacturers such as GAC Toyota, FAW Toyota, Li Auto, Geely, Chery, and BYD. The aviation segment serves domestic military and civil aircraft manufacturers, including those involved with the C919 commercial aircraft. The company’s products cater primarily to the automotive engine parts market and aerospace defense and civil aviation sectors.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company’s operations and sales are predominantly within China, with over 98% of revenue generated domestically. It also exports a smaller portion of products internationally. Major production and R&D facilities are located in Chengdu and Wuhu, China.
categories.supply_chain_position: Chengdu Xiling PowerScience&Technology operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain, focusing on manufacturing and assembly of automotive engine components and aerospace parts. It controls raw material processing such as casting and forging internally but also procures key raw materials and components externally. The company supplies directly to OEMs, acting as a key tier supplier.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic priorities include expanding turbocharger production capacity, developing new products like air springs, electric air conditioning compressors, EPS motors, and brake motors, and entering the robotics parts market. R&D efforts emphasize automation, digital manufacturing, new material development, and adaptation to new energy vehicle technologies. It also focuses on supply chain optimization and cost control to enhance competitiveness.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of manufactured automotive engine parts and aerospace components to OEMs and military clients. The company uses a direct sales model with long-term supply contracts and engages in product development collaborations with customers. It does not rely on subscription or licensing but on product sales and processing services.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: In automotive engine parts, competitors include Ningbo Tuopu Group, Metaldyne (Suzhou), Yunnan Xiyi Industrial, and foreign companies like BorgWarner and Mitsubishi Heavy Industries. The turbocharger market is dominated by foreign firms with strong R&D capabilities. Chengdu Xiling PowerScience&Technology holds a strong domestic position with growing market share in turbochargers and established relationships with major OEMs. In aerospace parts, it competes regionally with firms like Chengdu Aileda and Sichuan Tomorrow Aerospace, leveraging integrated manufacturing advantages.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 1.75 billion, a 15.38% increase year-over-year, and a net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 50.6 million, reversing previous losses. The automotive segment accounts for over 90% of revenue, with aerospace parts growing 46.14%. The company has about 2,523 employees and total assets of RMB 3.15 billion. It is investing in capacity expansion and R&D, showing a positive growth trajectory.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its integrated manufacturing capabilities from casting to final assembly, enabling quality control and cost advantages. It offers a broad product portfolio covering multiple key engine components, enhancing customer convenience and supply chain stability. Its R&D strength and close collaboration with leading OEMs support product innovation and customization. Cost leadership, quality certifications, and expanding turbocharger production capacity differentiate it in a competitive market.
